PluginData.Tooltip: v0.7.2: ore search, SDX2 estimates and nearby deposit guidance.
PluginData.Description: Core-style native menus, learned ore search and simple pings. Reads completed SDX2 client scan estimates; independently maps approximate ore deposits within 5 km. These are sampled estimates, not exact server quantities. Disable the old local ZeosOreHelper entry before enabling this version, then fully restart. Existing settings and learning are preserved. Windows/Pulsar Legacy only; in-game catalog verification pending.
